items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was Art, a Caucasian guy, he was a good drummer too

ctx.x: Right, oh yeah, because, right, right.

I kind of know what you mean, but I never thought about it, except that I can naively say that I don't think there was a style in Detroit because there was Oliver Jackson, Leon Rice, there was Art, a Caucasian guy, he was a good drummer too...
